name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash Spark-vLLM b12x
description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 双节点 TP=2 Spark-vLLM 服务：eugr/spark-vllm-b12x 镜像、B12X MLA SPARSE 注意力 + b12x MoE/线性层、dspark 投机 k=5、FP8 KV 缓存、instanttensor 加载 + AOT 编译、1M 上下文。
compose_template:
services:
  vllm-spark:
    image: ${SPARK_VLLM_IMAGE:-eugr/spark-vllm-b12x:latest}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-rank${NODE_RANK}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${VLLM_PORT:-8000}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    entrypoint: []
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "64gb"
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
    gpus: all
    devices:
      - /dev/infiniband:/dev/infiniband
    volumes:
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/cache/huggingface
      - ${HOME}/.cache/vllm-cache:/cache/huggingface/vllm-cache
      - ${SPARK_TMP_HOST:-${HOME}/.cache/spark-tmp}:/tmp
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载，避免启动时访问 HF
      TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: "${TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE:-0}"
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      # 挂载到宿主 vllm-cache 目录（kernel 编译/AOT/autotune 缓存持久化，容器重建不丢）
      VLLM_CACHE_ROOT: /cache/huggingface/vllm-cache
      VLLM_HOST_IP: "${VLLM_HOST_IP:-}"
      VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN: "${VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1}"
      VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB: "${VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB:-256}"
      VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS: "${VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS:-0}"
      # spark-vllm-b12x 镜像特性开关（源 docker run 的 -e 原样带入，可覆盖）
      VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE: "${VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT: "${VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT:--1}"
      VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILE_INCLUDE_ATTN: "${VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILE_INCLUDE_ATTN:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER: "${VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH: "${VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH:-0}"
      VLLM_USE_B12X_WO_PROJECTION: "${VLLM_USE_B12X_WO_PROJECTION:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_B12X_MHC: "${VLLM_USE_B12X_MHC:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_B12X_FP8_GEMM: "${VLLM_USE_B12X_FP8_GEMM:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_B12X_MOE: "${VLLM_USE_B12X_MOE:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_B12X_SPARSE_INDEXER: "${VLLM_USE_B12X_SPARSE_INDEXER:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "${VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER:-1}"
      B12X_MLA_SM120_UNIFIED: "${B12X_MLA_SM120_UNIFIED:-1}"
      B12X_MOE_FORCE_A8: "${B12X_MOE_FORCE_A8:-1}"
      # CuTeDSL 编译目标锁定 GB10（sm_121a）
      CUTE_DSL_ARCH: "${CUTE_DSL_ARCH:-sm_121a}"
      FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK: "${FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK:-1}"
      FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE: "${FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE:-/cache/huggingface/flashinfer}"
      TILELANG_CLEANUP_TEMP_FILES: "${TILELANG_CLEANUP_TEMP_FILES:-1}"
      TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "${TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST:-12.1a}"
      FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "${FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST:-12.1a}"
      # 网络：原命令的 $IFACE_NAME/$IB_IF 为宿主 shell 变量，这里映射为自动填充的
      # NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME(netdev)/NCCL_IB_HCA(hca)，GLOO/TP/MN/OMPI/UCX 同网卡
      NCCL_NET: "${NCCL_NET:-IB}"
      NCCL_IB_HCA: "${NCCL_IB_HCA:-}"
      NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME:-}"
      TP_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${TP_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      MN_IF_NAME: "${MN_IF_NAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include: "${OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      UCX_NET_DEVICES: "${UCX_NET_DEVICES:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX: "${NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_AUTO: "1"
      NCCL_IB_ADDR_FAMILY: AF_INET
      NCCL_IB_ROCE_VERSION_NUM: 2
      NCCL_IB_DISABLE: "0"
      NCCL_CROSS_NIC: "1"
      NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY: "1"
      NCCL_DEBUG: WARN
      # 投机解码 k 必须 ≥ checkpoint dspark_block_size(5)：k<5 静默截断草稿块
      # 放入容器环境，使命令内 $${MTP_NUM_TOKENS} 展开为真实值（.env 只影响 compose 插值）
      MTP_NUM_TOKENS: "${MTP_NUM_TOKENS:-5}"
      # cudagraph 编译模式与生成覆盖（JSON，容器内经 $${COMPILATION_CONFIG} 展开）
      COMPILATION_CONFIG: "${COMPILATION_CONFIG:-{\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE\",\"custom_ops\":[\"all\"]}}"
      DEFAULT_THINKING: "${DEFAULT_THINKING:-high}"
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: expandable_segments:True
    command:
      - bash
      - -lc
      - >
        export PATH="/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$${PATH:-}";
        export CUDA_HOME="$${CUDA_HOME:-/usr/local/cuda}";
        export CUDA_PATH="$${CUDA_PATH:-$${CUDA_HOME}}";
        export CUDAToolkit_ROOT="$${CUDAToolkit_ROOT:-$${CUDA_HOME}}";
        export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/cuda/lib64:$${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}";
        DEFAULT_THINKING_MODE="$${DEFAULT_THINKING:-high}";
        case "$${DEFAULT_THINKING_MODE}" in
          off) DEFAULT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS='{"thinking":false}' ;;
          low) DEFAULT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS='{"thinking":true,"reasoning_effort":"low"}' ;;
          high) DEFAULT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS='{"thinking":true,"reasoning_effort":"high"}' ;;
          max) DEFAULT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS='{"thinking":true,"reasoning_effort":"max"}' ;;
          *) echo "DEFAULT_THINKING 必须为 off/low/high/max（当前: $${DEFAULT_THINKING_MODE}）" >&2; exit 2 ;;
        esac;
        SPECULATIVE_CONFIG="{\"method\":\"dspark\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":$${MTP_NUM_TOKENS:-5},\"draft_sample_method\":\"probabilistic\",\"attention_backend\":\"B12X_MLA_SPARSE\"}";
        [ -n "$${COMPILATION_CONFIG:-}" ] || COMPILATION_CONFIG='{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","custom_ops":["all"]}';
        exec /usr/local/bin/vllm serve ${SPARK_MODEL:-deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731}
        --served-model-name ${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-deepseek-v4-flash}
        --host ${VLLM_HOST:-0.0.0.0}
        --port ${VLLM_PORT:-8000}
        --trust-remote-code
        --tensor-parallel-size 2
        --pipeline-parallel-size 1
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8
        --block-size 256
        --max-model-len ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1048576}
        --max-num-seqs ${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-8}
        --max-num-batched-tokens ${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS:-8192}
        --max-cudagraph-capture-size ${MAX_CUDAGRAPH_CAPTURE_SIZE:-64}
        --gpu-memory-utilization ${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.85}
        --enable-prefix-caching
        --enable-prompt-tokens-details
        --async-scheduling
        --enable-chunked-prefill
        --load-format ${LOAD_FORMAT:-instanttensor}
        --speculative-config "$${SPECULATIVE_CONFIG}"
        --compilation-config "$${COMPILATION_CONFIG}"
        --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4
        --distributed-executor-backend mp
        --moe-backend b12x
        --linear-backend b12x
        --attention-backend B12X_MLA_SPARSE
        --tool-call-parser deepseek_v4
        --enable-auto-tool-choice
        --reasoning-parser deepseek_v4
        --reasoning-config '{"reasoning_parser":"deepseek_v4","reasoning_start_str":" thinking","reasoning_end_str":" response"}'
        --default-chat-template-kwargs "$${DEFAULT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS}"
        --nnodes ${NODES_TOTAL:-2}
        --node-rank ${NODE_RANK}
        --master-addr ${MASTER_ADDR}
        --master-port ${MASTER_PORT:-25000}
        ${HEADLESS:+--headless}

variables.label: vLLM 镜像
variables.help: 从已拉取镜像中选择（控制平面先拉取再分发）
variables.help_en: Pick from pulled images (control plane pulls then distributes)

variables.label: 模型
variables.help: 从已下载模型中选择（控制平面下载后分发到各节点缓存）
variables.help_en: Pick from downloaded models (control plane downloads and distributes)

variables.label: CUDA Graph 捕获上限
variables.help: CUDA-Graph 捕获上限，源固定 64（默认）；上调兼容更大批次但更占显存
variables.help_en: CUDA-graph capture cap, source-pinned 64 (default); raising it allows larger capture batches at more memory

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help: 默认 0.85；0.80 实机验证稳定，0.90 无法开机
variables.help_en: Default 0.85; 0.80 hardware-validated stable, 0.90 fails to boot

variables.label: 模型加载格式
variables.help: 模型加载格式（源 instanttensor）；分发为标准 HF safetensors 时改空(auto)或 safetensors
variables.help_en: Load format (source: instanttensor); for standard HF safetensors distribution set empty (auto) or safetensors

variables.label: DSpark 投机 token 数
variables.help: dspark 投机 token 数，勿低于 dspark_block_size(5)，否则草稿块被静默截断、吞吐下降
variables.help_en: dspark speculative tokens; keep ≥ dspark_block_size(5) or draft blocks are silently truncated

variables.label: CUDA Graph 编译模式
variables.help: CUDA-Graph 编译模式：FULL_AND_PIECEWISE + custom_ops=all（源默认）；FULL_DECODE_ONLY 只捕获 decode（实测零损耗）
variables.help_en: CUDA-graph compile mode: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE + custom_ops all (source default); FULL_DECODE_ONLY captures decode only (measured cost-free)

variables.label: 默认思考模式
variables.help: off 不生成思考（最快）；low/high/max 开启思考并控制 effort；请求级可覆盖
variables.help_en: off: no thinking (fastest); low/high/max: thinking with reasoning effort; overridable per request

variables.label: Head 节点地址
variables.help: 自动填充 head 节点的 RoCE IP（多节点协调地址，随任务的 head 变化）
variables.help_en: Filled with the head node's RoCE IP (multi-node coordination address, follows per-task head)

variables.label: 节点总数
variables.help: 由任务节点数自动填充（本配方为固定 2 节点拓扑，发布时校验恰好匹配）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled from task node count (fixed 2-node topology; publish validates exact match)

variables.label: Headless（worker 不跑 API server）
variables.help: 自动按角色填充：head 为空、worker 为 1（mp 多节点协调必需）

variables.label: 本节点 vLLM 绑定 IP
variables.help: 必须为各节点 RoCE IP，避免分布式绑定错误地址
variables.help_en: Must be each node's RoCE IP to avoid binding the wrong address

variables.label: RoCE GID index
variables.help: 每节点/HCA 不同且重启漂移，自动解析

description_en: 2-node TP=2 Spark-vLLM serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: eugr/spark-vllm-b12x image, B12X MLA SPARSE attention + b12x MoE/linear, dspark speculation k=5, FP8 KV cache, instanttensor load with AOT compile, 1M context.
